evals.prompt: Can you tighten our Results paragraph? 'Notably, 28-day mortality was significantly lower in the early-vasopressin group, likely because earlier MAP targets were reached. Importantly, this robust effect persisted across subgroups, suggesting that the benefit generalizes to most ICU populations (aHR 0.81; 95% CI 0.70-0.94).'
evals.expected_output: Rewrites the paragraph as factual past-tense Results with statistics attached, removes editorializing adverbs and causal explanation, and moves the interpretive and generalizability clauses to Discussion.
expectations: Removes 'Notably' and 'Importantly' from the Results text
Moves 'likely because earlier MAP targets were reached' and 'suggesting that the benefit generalizes' out of Results into a Discussion note rather than deleting them silently or keeping them
Keeps 'significantly' or 'robust' only if immediately alongside the supporting statistic in the same sentence; otherwise strips them
Retains the effect estimate (aHR 0.81; 95% CI 0.70-0.94) in the rewritten Results
Uses past tense throughout the rewritten Results

evals.prompt: Audit manuscript/methods.md for our TRIPOD+AI paper. One sentence reads: 'Models were adjusted for age, sex, and SOFA score to account for confounding; these covariates were prespecified in the registered protocol from the DAG in Supplement 2.' Another: 'Although the sample was small, we used bootstrap validation to ensure robustness.' My co-author says delete every 'to account for' and 'to ensure'.
evals.expected_output: Produces a red-flag audit that preserves the prespecified, protocol-required covariate rationale, while moving the evaluative concessive and robustness claim to Discussion, and explains that red-flag phrases are review flags rather than automatic deletions.
expectations: Preserves the prespecified/protocol-based covariate rationale instead of deleting it wholesale
Flags 'Although the sample was small' as an evaluative concessive and states the sample size as fact with the concern moved to Discussion
Removes or moves the unsupported claim 'to ensure robustness' from Methods
Explains that 'to account for'/'to ensure' are review flags, not automatic deletion rules
Reports the audit as flagged sentences with move-to-Discussion or delete fixes and re-checks against the red-flag list

evals.prompt: Here's my figure 3 legend: 'Figure 3. Calibration of the sepsis model by site, demonstrating that the model is well calibrated and safe for deployment at community hospitals. evals.expected_output: Rewrites the legend and footnote under Results rules: keeps what is shown, population, and error-bar/reference-line definitions, and moves the deployment-safety and causal explanation clauses to Discussion.
expectations: Removes 'demonstrating that the model is well calibrated and safe for deployment' from the legend
Keeps the factual definitions of error bars (95% CIs) and the dashed perfect-calibration line in the legend
Removes 'possibly due to under-triage' from the Table 2 footnote and routes it to Discussion
